City bridge reopened after repairs

The central bridge reopened on Friday after six months of repairs, city officials said.

Traffic is expected to return to normal within a week, and bus routes 12 and 14 resume their old paths.

Engineers replaced 40 meters of decking and strengthened two support beams.
